ice: Vents only count the time you spend in SOURCE: one hunter every 4 seconds there, and every 2 seconds during a TRACE.
Hunters freeze and go harmless in RENDER, then vanish about a second after you flip back.
Hunters run along the floor, so walls give you no cover in SOURCE. One touch is a fail.
melt: SOURCE adds 12 % melt a second. RENDER takes 4 % off. Every flip adds 5 % on top.
The meter warns at 70 %. At 100 % you have about 0.6 seconds before the reboot.
A flip back to RENDER is refused if you would land inside a wall, so check where you will come out before you flip.
trace: A camera or drone cone that holds you for half a second starts a TRACE. A TRACE lasts 6 seconds.
Three TRACEs in one room set off the alarm and restart it. Cameras are blind in SOURCE, so flip to break their view.
UNSTABLE runs a 90-second countdown. Reach the exit before it runs out.
glitch: Standing in a glitch zone starts a 3-second countdown. When it reaches zero, the game flips you.
A forced flip still follows the flip rule: it is refused if it would leave you inside a wall.
Leaving the zone resets the countdown.
drone: Guard drones are solid in RENDER and kill on touch. In SOURCE they are hidden and harmless, but they keep flying.
A hijack pad takes control of its drone for 10 seconds. A hijacked drone never detects you.
A hijacked drone blinds any camera cone it overlaps and blocks ICE hunters.
architect: The Architect's gaze turns a full circle every 14 seconds and sees both layers. Flipping does not hide you from it.
Move while the gaze cone points away from you. Timing matters more than cover here.
Each shield terminal sits in a closed pod. Phase into the pod in SOURCE, flip back, then hack.
